name: US equity stress
summary: VIX just under 20 and S&P 500 3% off its high ahead of a busy week
state: US markets have been shut since the 30 Oct close, when the S&P 500 stood about 3% below its 52-week high and the VIX at 19.4, just under the 20 Watch line. The week ahead brings the 3 Nov US midterms, the 5 Nov Bank of England decision and US payrolls on 6 Nov.
for_you: Share prices are moving within normal ranges. Pension and investment values may swing more around the elections and central bank decisions this week.
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
